title: AVM FRITZ!Box DECT Smart Home
description: matterbridge-ai-factory-avm-fritz-box v. 1.0.0 - FRITZ!DECT plugs, thermostats, lights, sensors and roller shutters via the AHA-HTTP interface.

host.title: FRITZ!Box Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the FRITZ!Box (e.g. 192.168.1.1 or fritz.box).

username.title: Username
username.description: FRITZ!Box user name. Leave empty if your box uses password-only login.

password.title: Password
password.description: FRITZ!Box password with Smart Home permission.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
pollInterval.description: How often device states are refreshed from the FRITZ!Box.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (debugging only).
